title: Q-INTRO-1: Intro outreach goes live: sender worker on Cloudflare Email Service, inbound reply capture, prospect growth
body:
**Owner:** outreach-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/outreach_inbound.js::intro:
**Status:** closed

OUTREACH-INTRO-1 shipped the engine (scripts/outreach_intro.py, dry-run). Remaining server-side links, built by the executor: (1) a Worker route that receives mail on Cloudflare Email Routing for the reply address and calls the reply recorder with kind inferred from the text (stop => opt-out, bounce => bounce, else ack), so no person records replies by hand; (2) the OUTREACH_SEND_URL adapter Worker that sends through Cloudflare Email Sending from the registered sender, adds the postal address and reply-to, and records outcomes; (3) a weekly step that adds prospects from the segments (organizations found through jobs and institute listings the system already tracks) via `outreach_intro.py add`. The owner-only acts (register the sending domain, state the postal address, set mode=live) are one machine-readable gate with dry-run as the default in effect.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/outreach_inbound.js::intro:

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 174.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
